agent_note: Complete, 40/40 quotes. First-person retrospective past narration throughout; a heavy second-person aphoristic layer (gnomic) reflects this source's quotability bias, not the book's tense. Past-tense generalizations ('You had to seize the day', 'Running had been my ex Patrick's thing', the Gopnik charity passage) kept as event/past per the present-only gnomic rule. Quotation marks survive well here, so mark-absence was treated as weak evidence for narration; where marks were absent the signals used were vocatives (q03195), character idiolect (q03210), and direct address/register (q03204, q03207, q03209). q03233 is the only present event quote and is the flip risk. q03215 abstained (all caps, bucket undeterminable). Counts: event 20 (19 past / 1 present, 95% past), dialogue 11, gnomic 8, unclear 1.
